description: Native access for the main app webview only; browser child webviews receive no capabilities. Raw-hash signing, key reveal, account import, the legacy native WebAuthn bridge and drive listing are deliberately not granted because this webview also hosts third-party wallet frames. The vault-layer commands (layer_*, open_location_settings) pin their relying party, origin and settings URI in Rust and, like every grant here, apply to the app's own local origin only.
